'''Frem''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] citizen of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]] living during the [[war against Zakuul]]. By the time [[Empress/Legends|Empress]] [[Vaylin]] took the [[Eternal Throne]], Frem was a [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] in the ranks of the [[Knights of Zakuul]]. During the [[Grand Festival of Empress Vaylin]] in [[3630 BBY]] he was present in the [[Palace of the Eternal Dragon]] barracks where he told several Knights, including an initiate named [[Alus]], the story of [[Watcher Izax]]. Vaylin's speech was interrupted by the arrival of first [[Alliance Commander]] and then former Emperor [[Arcann]]. In an effort to kill them both, Vaylin ordered the [[Eternal Fleet]] to bomb the Palace into rubble, regardless of her supporters still inside.<ref name="SWTOR" /> Later, during the [[Mission to Kira Carsen's ship|final confrontation]] with [[Tenebrae]], Frem was among the spirits witnessing his final [[Death/Legends|death]].<ref name="Echoes">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=General|Echoes of Oblivion|Kira Carsen's ship}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Frem appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' during "Chapter VI: The Dragon's Maw."
